text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64.5K with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 1.3% gain, suggesting selective strength in smart-contract assets despite broad caution. Extreme Fear sentiment (25) and falling dominance (56.6%) indicate traders are rotating away from BTC into altcoins, though total volume remains modest at $55B, limiting conviction behind the move. The 7-day sentiment decline and weakness in layer-1 alternatives like Solana suggest anxiety is deepening rather than stabilizing.
